changes: Audited every git status --porcelain consumer in packages/main/src for the B-b264 whole-output-trim first-row bug class. Fixed the four consumers where the corrupted first row reached classification logic — core/evidence-freshness.ts readMaterialDirtyFiles (evidence hash snapshots), handlers/cross-host-review.ts assertMaterialCleanForReview (review dirty preflight), handlers/story-query.ts gitPorcelainPaths (story_sync_main preflight; also rename rows now resolve to the new path) and core/partial-done-recovery.ts assertMainWorktreeClean (done_recover clean guard) — plus two display-only sites (handlers/session.ts brief rows, story-query DONE-residue status text). All use the B-b264 raw-read pattern: no full-output trim, split then per-line trimEnd, emptiness decided on rows.length. Added packages/main/src/tasks/porcelain-first-row-audit-smoke.ts (11 scenarios staging a modified-TRACKED first porcelain row with a fixture-shape guard) and the test:porcelain-first-row-audit script. The per-site audit verdict table for all untouched call sites (safe by read pattern, safe by usage, shift-tolerant worktree.ts:617, immune-by-format worktree-list sites) is recorded in plan.md.
usage: No new commands or flags. Existing flows simply classify correctly now: cross_host_review and story_sync_main no longer false-block on a first-row .lattice metadata change, done_recover no longer refuses a volatile-only dirty main, evidence snapshots exclude first-row volatile artifacts, session brief shows intact status columns. Regression test: node packages/main/dist/tasks/porcelain-first-row-audit-smoke.js (or npm --prefix packages/main run test:porcelain-first-row-audit).
expectedOutcome: porcelain-first-row-audit-smoke passes all 11 scenarios against the fixed tree, the story-evidence repro (exit 1 at pre-fix baseline 2d08e79) exits 0, lattice validate all green, run-all-smokes shows PASS porcelain-first-row-audit with no new failures vs the pre-change baseline.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/porcelain-first-row-audit-smoke.js -> 11x ✓ + porcelain-first-row-audit-smoke: ALL PASS (exit 0). node .lattice/story/actives/B-d6a0/evidence/repro-porcelain-first-row.mjs -> GREEN (exit 0; RED exit 1 recorded at baseline 2d08e79 in red-evidence.json). lattice validate --story=B-d6a0 -> all 45 commands code=0, status pass. run-all-smokes -> PASS porcelain-first-row-audit (3.2s); remaining failures reproduced on unfixed main (stale retired-authority manifest entries, pre-existing smoke failures, slow playbook smokes that pass standalone).
outcomeDiff: none — expected and actual match on all four evidence commands
limitations: Cosmetic first-row corruption inside error-message echoes of emptiness-only call sites (release.ts, worktree.ts wtStatus sites, auxiliary-worktree-cleanup.ts) is documented in the plan.md audit table, not fixed (no classification impact). worktree.ts:617 purgeSafeInitCommit keeps its shift-tolerant parse (correct today, documented as load-bearing). Future porcelain consumers can still hand-roll a full-trim helper; the audit table plus the regression smoke are the guard, not a type-level constraint.
pitfalls: Untracked-only fixtures cannot detect this bug class — regression tests must stage a modified-TRACKED first porcelain row and assert row shape (/^ M /) before asserting classification. Do not reuse trimming helpers (git()/gitOutput()) for porcelain reads; use the raw-read pattern. materialDirtyFiles (not dirty.files) is the snapshot field name.
